primer: Gilead Sciences (GILD) is a high-margin HIV and oncology leader with $9.46B in FY25 free cash flow. At $166.43 (live feed $170.37), GILD trades above Base fair value and fails 1.50:1 asymmetry even at $158.85–$168.74 support. We assign REJECTED (TIER_0, VALUATION), pass on the $170/$200 call spread (NO_OPTIONS_EDGE), and await a $130.00–$135.00 reset.
